title: Small Compiler Subset Parser Under Ruby Referee
purpose: Parse a tiny approved BASIC# compiler subset from tokenizer/reader records while the existing Ruby Parser remains the production authority and referee.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_parser.rb as a non-production parser experiment
parsing accepted Head, Body, result marker, and official action word structure from TokenizerReader records
comparing the subset parser output against the existing Ruby Parser referee
recording deterministic parser records for future self-hosting work
preserving existing runtime, BSharp IR, BSharp Bytecode, Save, ASK, input devices, web, and browser behavior
forbidden_until_later_approval: replacing compiler/parser.rb as the production parser authority
routing normal BASIC# compilation through compiler/small_compiler_subset_parser.rb
changing runtime meaning, BSharp IR, BSharp Bytecode, Save format, ASK output, input devices, graphics, engine bridge, browser work, web export, or Ruby retirement

subset_statement_schema.starter: accepted Head word such as START or WHEN
subset_statement_schema.head: accepted Head detail, such as event text after WHEN, or null for standalone Heads
subset_statement_schema.line_number: one-based source line number for the Head
subset_statement_schema.body_open_line: one-based source line for [ when present
subset_statement_schema.body_close_line: one-based source line for ]. when present
subset_statement_schema.children: ordered subset child records parsed from Body lines

subset_child_schema.body: Body text after stripping accepted |then marker when present
subset_child_schema.result_marker: then when an accepted |then marker is present
subset_child_schema.action: official action word without opening parenthesis when present
subset_child_schema.line_number: one-based source line number for the Body line

acceptance_rules: The small compiler subset parser tool must pass in the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
compiler/small_compiler_subset_parser.rb must parse from TokenizerReader reader records.
Subset parser records must match the existing Ruby Parser referee for accepted fixture structure.
The new subset parser must not become the production parser in this build.
No Profile 8, syntax, runtime, bytecode, web export, browser, engine bridge, or Ruby retirement work is allowed.
